title: Sum Of Even Numbers After Queries
description: Given an array of integers nums and an array of queries, for each query, update nums and return the sum of all even values in the array.
pseudocode:
1. sum = nums.filter(x => x % 2 === 0).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
2. for (let [val, i] of queries) {
3.   if (nums[i] % 2 === 0) sum -= nums[i]
4.   nums[i] += val
5.   if (nums[i] % 2 === 0) sum += nums[i]
6.   res.push(sum)
7. }

steps.note: Calculate initial sum of even numbers: [1, 2, 3, 4] -> 2 + 4 = 6
Processing query [1, 0]: nums[0] is 1 (odd), no change to sum.
nums[0] is now 2 (even), add to sum: 6 + 2 = 8
Processing query [-3, 1]: nums[1] is 2 (even), remove from sum: 8 - 2 = 6
